packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major npm updates
Group and automerge non-major GitHub Actions
Group Tailwind packages together (all update types)
site-functions is RUNTIME-ONLY (never executed by site CI) and exact-pinned - propagation is deliberate via the engine's fleet-bump PRs, not Renovate (phase-12 D3 pin model)
Internal packages - minor/patch automerge (CI executes these via astro build, so a bad minor fails the PR; phase-12 D4). Majors stay manual via the last rule.

Hold TypeScript MAJOR behind Dependency-Dashboard approval instead of auto-opening a PR. TS7 (Go-native, GA 2026-07-08) ships without a stable programmatic compiler API until TS 7.1 (~Oct 2026), so @astrojs/check (peer: typescript ^5||^6) — which powers `astro check` — refuses it and the bump fails CI fleet-wide. Dashboard approval keeps the TS major VISIBLE + one-click on the dashboard (never silently dropped like allowedVersions would), so it is not forgotten: tick the box to re-test once @astrojs/check widens its peer range to include ^7. TS minor/patch still auto-flow.
Safety guard: never automerge major updates (must stay last to override the group rules above)
